About
1995
2026
Three decades of engineering evolution.

Since 1995, IAQ has continuously expanded its engineering capabilities, project delivery expertise and global presence in support of advanced technology industries. From our foundations in Malaysia to projects across multiple international markets, our journey reflects a steadfast commitment to engineering excellence, innovation and long-term value creation.

Milestones
READING
2026
Supporting the Next Generation of Industry
21 of 21
1995
Foundation of IAQ

IAQ was established in Malaysia with a focus on engineering-led solutions for controlled environments and technology-driven industries, laying the foundation for a commitment to quality, reliability and technical excellence.

The IAQ headquarters, Shah Alam.
2000
Regional Expansion

IAQ expanded beyond Malaysia, delivering large-scale industrial facilities and strengthening its capabilities in cleanroom, utility and infrastructure solutions for advanced manufacturing environments.

Shown for illustration.
2002
Advancing Technical Expertise

As demand for higher-performance facilities grew, IAQ broadened its engineering capabilities to support specialised manufacturing environments requiring stringent environmental control and utility integration.

Shown for illustration.
2006
Integrated Facility Delivery

IAQ strengthened its multidisciplinary approach by delivering complete facility solutions encompassing architecture, mechanical and electrical systems, process utilities and building infrastructure.

A semiconductor plant, shown for illustration.
2008
Building International Experience in Europe

IAQ continued to develop its presence in international markets while enhancing expertise in facility optimisation, engineering analysis and operational performance improvement.

Shown for illustration.
2009
Supporting Semiconductor Manufacturing

IAQ further strengthened its cleanroom and process facility expertise through project requiring highly controlled manufacturing environment and integrated utility systems.

Shown for illustration.
2011
Growth in Electronics Manufacturing

As global demand for advanced electronics accelerated, IAQ supported facility expansions and manufacturing infrastructure developments requiring high-precision engineering execution.

A finished cleanroom ballroom built by IAQ, shown for illustration.
2013
Diversification into Energy Infrastructure

IAQ expanded into energy and utility infrastructure projects, applying its engineering expertise to large-scale developments supporting long-term operational reliability.

The primary chilled water pumps of a district cooling plant, as an illustration.
2014
Expanding Industrial Capabilities

The company continued to support a broader range of industrial and manufacturing projects, reinforcing its role as a multidisciplinary engineering and construction partner.

An industrial manufacturing hall, shown for illustration.
2015
Delivering Critical Infrastructure

IAQ completed major utility infrastructure developments while strengthening long-term maintenance and operational support capabilities across complex facilities.

A central utility plant, shown for illustration.
2016
Strengthening Energy Solutions

Building on its growing experience in utility infrastructure, IAQ expanded its involvement in sustainable energy and district cooling developments.

Shown for illustration.
2017
Infrastructure and Transportation Projects

IAQ broadened its project portfolio through participation in large-scale public infrastructure developments, further enhancing its multidisciplinary project delivery expertise.

Public infrastructure, shown for illustration.
2018
Supporting Semiconductor Growth

As semiconductor investment accelerated across the region, IAQ continued strengthening its capabilities in wafer fabrication and advanced manufacturing facilities.

Utilities above a cleanroom bay built by IAQ, shown for illustration.
2019
Scaling Project Delivery

The successful delivery of large-scale industrial facilities demonstrated IAQ's growing capability in managing complex project through integrated engineering and construction delivery models.

A semiconductor plant from the air, shown for illustration.
2020
Entry into EV Battery Manufacturing

IAQ entered the rapidly expanding EV battery sector, extending its expertise into specialised manufacturing facilities supporting the global energy transition.

A battery gigafactory from the air, shown for illustration.
2021
Enhancing Construction Management Services

The company further developed its construction management capabilities, supporting complex developments through effective coordination, planning and execution.

A construction site run by IAQ, shown for illustration.
2022
Continued Regional Growth

IAQ strengthened its regional presence while delivering large-scale industrial developments that showcased resilience, adaptability and engineering excellence.

A plant built by IAQ, shown for illustration.
2023
Expansion into Data Centres

Responding to the rapid growth of digital infrastructure, IAQ expanded into data centre developments, supporting mission-critical facilities that demand reliability and operational continuity.

A chilled water plant room, the HVAC wet system, as an illustration.
2024ACHIEVEMENT
Recognition for Project Excellence

Industry recognition reinforced IAQ's commitment to quality, safety and project delivery excellence while continuing to support increasingly sophisticated manufacturing facilities.

The IAQ team at the MCIEA 2024 awards night.
2025
Strengthening Global Presence

IAQ expanded its international footprint and continued delivering highly complex semiconductor and advanced technology facilities across multiple regions.

A wafer fab complex from the air, shown for illustration.
2026
Supporting the Next Generation of Industry

Today, IAQ continues to support advanced manufacturing and critical infrastructure developments worldwide, helping clients transform ambitious visions into operationally successful facilities.

An advanced manufacturing plant, shown for illustration.
What three decades have proved.

Each is on record in IAQ’s company profile, its newsroom or the project registry.

PROJECT
235+ projects delivered
Hi-tech facilities delivered since 1995 for semiconductor, district cooling, life science and industrial clients, locally and globally.
CLEANROOM CLASS
ISO Class 1
The highest standard of cleanroom IAQ has built, delivered successfully for a semiconductor client.
ENERGY
Malaysia's largest district cooling
Main contractor on the scheme, delivered with a 25 year maintenance mandate.
FIRST IN REGION
First co-generative plant in Southeast Asia
Delivered in Malaysia as part of IAQ’s energy work.
AWARD · 2024
Builder of the Year
Named at the Malaysian Construction Industry Excellence Awards by CIDB, judged on company performance, project management, technical expertise, innovation, quality, safety and sustainability.
AWARD · 2024
Gold, OSH Management
Gold Award for OSH Management at the 20th OSH Excellence Awards, alongside the Highwire Safety Award at Gold level.
TOTAL FACILITY SOLUTIONS

Engineering and facility solutions since 1995.
